scientific_integrity: Self-contained Fourier-block proof and replayable direct-matrix numerical checker; numerical tests support but do not establish the asymptotic theorem. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact result for even unweighted cycles, alternate-vertex spatial sampling, two fixed heat-time observations, and combinatorial Laplacian; finite optimizer uniqueness not established, other sensor patterns not covered. Bibliographic priority is provisional.
title: Arithmetic blind spots and an optimal two-time heat-sampling delay on cycles
